title: ActorModelManageRequest
description: actor.model-manage-request@1: the body of PUT /api/v1/me/model on OpenVibe.Actor: { choice, model? }. choice is 'auto' (Actor decides, as before), 'openvibe' (OpenVibe's own keys, through OpenVibe.AI) or 'own:<provider>' (your own key for that provider: openai, anthropic, deepseek, google, openrouter or mistral). model is the model id you picked for it, or nothing: OpenVibe.AI then routes the call. The key itself never reaches Actor: it stays sealed in OpenVibe.AI. An unknown provider or a model id that is not one is 422 actor.model.invalid.

choice.description: Which model your tasks run on.

model.description: The model id you picked, or nothing: OpenVibe.AI routes the call.
